_comment: Manual mutation testing (docs/dev/testing-strategy.md §6). Not wired into check:fast or check:deep. Narrow the SOURCE scope per run with `--mutate`; never narrow the TEST command — a runner that skips a test file reports every mutant only that file would kill as a survivor, and hand-triaging those false survivors costs more than the runtime saved.
commandRunner_comment: The runner is `bun run test:mutation` = the whole suite minus six port-binding / process-spawning files. Those bind real ports (docs/dev/testing-strategy.md §5.8), so under Stryker's concurrent workers they fail on collision and FALSELY KILL mutants — measured: tests/start-run-server.test.ts failed 2 of 4 concurrent full-suite runs. None of the six exercise pure request-path logic, so excluding them costs no kills.
